trap.label: explain me
trap.wrong: The speaker explained me the process.
trap.right: The speaker explained the process to me.
trap.why: Em português "explicou-me". Em inglês, explain pede to antes da pessoa.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com in my opinion: “According to me, it is fair.”
rewrite.answer: In my opinion, it is fair.

rewrite.prompt: Passe ao passado: “Sales rise in May.”
Reescreva com although: “It is cheap. It is poor.”
rewrite.answer: Although it is cheap, it is poor.
